title: 环境与气候精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 这个容器可以重复使用，只要盖子还能密封。
items.en: This container can be reused as long as the lid still seals properly.
answers: This container can be reused as long as the lid still seals properly.
items.notes: can be reused 是情态被动；as long as 提出重复使用的条件。

items.zh: 与其买瓶装水，我带了一个可补水的水瓶。
items.en: Rather than buy bottled water, I brought a refillable bottle.
answers: Rather than buy bottled water, I brought a refillable bottle.
items.notes: rather than 后接动词原形；brought 是 bring 的过去式，refillable 表示可补充装水的。

items.zh: 这些落叶会被收集起来，制成堆肥。
items.en: These fallen leaves will be collected and turned into compost.
answers: These fallen leaves will be collected and turned into compost.
items.notes: 两个将来时被动谓语共用 will be；turn into 表示变成。

items.zh: 虽然包装上印着回收标志，但当地不一定能处理这种材料。
items.en: Although the packaging carries a recycling symbol, local facilities may not be able to process this material.
answers: Although the packaging carries a recycling symbol, local facilities may not be able to process this material.
items.notes: carry a symbol 表示印有标志；may not 指能力并不确定。

items.zh: 暴雨过后，河水变得浑浊，岸边还堆着垃圾。
items.en: After the heavy rain, the river turned muddy and litter accumulated along its banks.
answers: After the heavy rain, the river turned muddy and litter accumulated along its banks.
items.notes: turn + 形容词描述状态变化；litter 为不可数名词，banks 在此指河岸。

items.zh: 你知道旧电池应该送到哪里回收吗？
items.en: Do you know where used batteries should be taken for recycling?
answers: Do you know where used batteries should be taken for recycling?
items.notes: where 后使用陈述语序；should be taken 是情态被动语态。

items.zh: 修好这双鞋，比直接换一双产生的废弃物更少。
items.en: Repairing these shoes creates less waste than replacing them.
answers: Repairing these shoes creates less waste than replacing them.
items.notes: repairing 与 replacing 比较两种行为；waste 在此不可数，用 less。

items.zh: 为了避免浪费食物，我会先看看冰箱里还有什么。
items.en: To avoid wasting food, I check what is already in the fridge first.
answers: To avoid wasting food, I check what is already in the fridge first.
items.notes: avoid 后接 doing；what 从句作 check 的宾语。

items.zh: 如果暖气开着，请把这扇窗关上。
items.en: Please close this window if the heating is on.
answers: Please close this window if the heating is on.
items.notes: be on 表示设备处于开启状态；if 引出操作条件。

items.zh: 让这个街区更凉快的，不只是树的数量，还有树荫的位置。
items.en: What makes this neighbourhood cooler is not just the number of trees but also where their shade falls.
answers: What makes this neighbourhood cooler is not just the number of trees but also where their shade falls.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；not just ... but also ... 并列评价因素。

items.zh: 自从安装了水表，我们就能更清楚地了解用水量。
items.en: Since the water meter was installed, we've been able to track our water use more clearly.
answers: Since the water meter was installed, we've been able to track our water use more clearly.
Since the water meter was installed, we have been able to track our water use more clearly.
items.notes: since 从句用过去时被动；track 在此表示持续了解或记录。

items.zh: 社区正在征集志愿者，帮助清理步道旁的垃圾。
items.en: The community is looking for volunteers to help remove litter beside the footpath.
answers: The community is looking for volunteers to help remove litter beside the footpath.
items.notes: look for 表示寻找；to help 说明志愿者参与的任务。

items.zh: 请把纸箱压平，这样回收桶里能放更多东西。
items.en: Please flatten the cardboard boxes so that more will fit in the recycling bin.
answers: Please flatten the cardboard boxes so that more will fit in the recycling bin.
items.notes: flatten：压平。

items.zh: 这件旧衣服还能穿，我打算把它捐出去。
items.en: This old garment is still wearable, so I plan to donate it.
answers: This old garment is still wearable, so I plan to donate it.
items.notes: wearable：还能穿的。

items.zh: 活动结束后，我们称了剩余食物的重量。
items.en: After the event, we weighed the leftover food.
answers: After the event, we weighed the leftover food.
items.notes: weigh 是动词，weight 是名词。

items.zh: 超市允许顾客自带容器购买这些商品。
items.en: The supermarket allows customers to buy these products in their own containers.
answers: The supermarket allows customers to buy these products in their own containers.
items.notes: allow sb to do。

items.zh: 我想知道这个清洁剂的补充装放在哪里。
items.en: I would like to know where the refills for this cleaner are kept.
answers: I would like to know where the refills for this cleaner are kept.
I'd like to know where the refills for this cleaner are kept.
items.notes: refill：补充装。

items.zh: 这盏灯接了定时器，不会整夜亮着。
items.en: This light is on a timer, so it will not stay on all night.
answers: This light is on a timer, so it will not stay on all night.
This light is on a timer, so it won't stay on all night.
items.notes: stay on：保持开启。

items.zh: 洗衣机还没装满，我们可以晚一点再开。
items.en: The washing machine is not full yet; we can run it later.
answers: The washing machine is not full yet; we can run it later.
The washing machine isn't full yet; we can run it later.
items.notes: run a machine：启动使用机器。

items.zh: 修理工说窗框的缝隙让很多热量散失了。
items.en: The repairer said gaps around the window frame were letting a lot of heat escape.
answers: The repairer said gaps around the window frame were letting a lot of heat escape.
items.notes: let sth do：使某事发生。

items.zh: 如果充电器不用了，请从插座上拔下来。
items.en: Please unplug the charger if it is no longer in use.
answers: Please unplug the charger if it is no longer in use.
items.notes: unplug：拔掉插头。

items.zh: 这段步道暂时关闭，以保护正在筑巢的鸟类。
items.en: This section of the trail is temporarily closed to protect nesting birds.
answers: This section of the trail is temporarily closed to protect nesting birds.
items.notes: to protect 表示关闭的目的。

items.zh: 我们观鸟时会保持距离，避免惊扰它们。
items.en: We keep our distance while birdwatching to avoid disturbing the birds.
answers: We keep our distance while birdwatching to avoid disturbing the birds.
items.notes: avoid 后接动名词。

items.zh: 清理海滩时，我们发现最多的是食品包装。
items.en: Food wrappers were the most common items we found during the beach clean-up.
answers: Food wrappers were the most common items we found during the beach clean-up.
items.notes: most common：最常见的。

items.zh: 请不要把园艺废物倒进这条小溪。
items.en: Please do not dump garden waste into this stream.
answers: Please do not dump garden waste into this stream.
Please don't dump garden waste into this stream.
items.notes: dump：倾倒。

items.zh: 新种的树在干旱期间需要有人照看。
items.en: The newly planted trees need someone to look after them during the drought.
answers: The newly planted trees need someone to look after them during the drought.
items.notes: newly planted：新种下的。

items.zh: 我想报名参加周末的修理工作坊，而不是立刻买新的。
items.en: I want to join the weekend repair workshop rather than immediately buy a replacement.
answers: I want to join the weekend repair workshop rather than immediately buy a replacement.
items.notes: replacement：替换物。

items.zh: 购买二手家具之前，我们先量了门的宽度。
items.en: Before buying second-hand furniture, we measured the width of the doorway.
answers: Before buying second-hand furniture, we measured the width of the doorway.
items.notes: furniture 为不可数名词。

items.zh: 这个过滤器可以拆下来清洗，不必每次都换。
items.en: This filter can be removed and washed instead of replaced each time.
answers: This filter can be removed and washed instead of replaced each time.
items.notes: 被动谓语共用 can be。

items.zh: 如果你只需要用一次，可以先看看邻居能否借给你。
items.en: If you only need it once, you could see whether a neighbour can lend it to you.
answers: If you only need it once, you could see whether a neighbour can lend it to you.
items.notes: lend ... to：借给。

items.zh: 我们把出行集中在同一天，减少了来回跑的次数。
items.en: We combined our errands into one day, reducing the number of separate trips.
answers: We combined our errands into one day, reducing the number of separate trips.
items.notes: errands：需要外出的日常事务。

items.zh: 这张标签没有解释“环保”具体指的是什么。
items.en: This label does not explain what environmentally friendly means in this case.
answers: This label does not explain what environmentally friendly means in this case.
This label doesn't explain what environmentally friendly means in this case.
items.notes: what 引出需要解释的含义。

items.zh: 我记下了烟雾出现的时间和位置，准备报告给相关部门。
items.en: I recorded when and where the smoke appeared so that I could report it to the relevant authority.
answers: I recorded when and where the smoke appeared so that I could report it to the relevant authority.
items.notes: when and where 并列信息。

items.zh: 昨晚的雨把新铺的泥土冲到了人行道上。
items.en: Last night's rain washed the newly laid soil onto the pavement.
answers: Last night's rain washed the newly laid soil onto the pavement.
items.notes: wash ... onto：把某物冲到某处。

items.zh: 我们正在比较不同灯泡的耗电量，而不只是价格。
items.en: We are comparing the power consumption of different bulbs, not just their prices.
answers: We are comparing the power consumption of different bulbs, not just their prices.
We're comparing the power consumption of different bulbs, not just their prices.
items.notes: power consumption：耗电量。

items.zh: 只要物品保持完好，这个交换点就接受捐赠。
items.en: This exchange point accepts donated items as long as they remain in good condition.
answers: This exchange point accepts donated items as long as they remain in good condition.
items.notes: in good condition：状况良好。
